title: Agricultural Markets Drive Sustainable Development
reason: Discusses the evolution and importance of agricultural markets and trade.

tasks.task: Examine the evolution and benefits of agricultural markets and trade.

subtasks.text: Trace the doubling of trade in food and agriculture since 1995.
Highlight the integration of one-third of global agricultural and food exports within global value chains today.

tasks.task: Describe the challenges and resilience of global value chains during the spread of COVID-19.

subtasks.text: Note the posed challenges to food markets due to the rapid spread of COVID-19.
Observe the resilience of global value chains in response to the challenges posed by COVID-19.

tasks.task: Explain the role of trade in promoting global food security and economic growth.

subtasks.text: Mention how trade moves food from surplus to deficit regions.
Note that trade helps to promote global food security.
Describe how trade can help to promote growth and reduce poverty.

tasks.task: Explore the role of appropriate actions and policies in driving sustainable development through trade.

subtasks.text: Note that with appropriate actions and policies, trade can drive sustainable economic, social, and environmental development.

tasks.task: Discuss the participation of developing countries in global agricultural markets.

subtasks.text: Mention that developing countries increasingly participate in global markets.
Highlight that their exports make up over a third of global agri-food trade.
Note that smallholder farmers in many developing countries lack the necessary resources to participate in modern markets.

tasks.task: Describe ways to foster market participation and sustainable development.

subtasks.text: Point out that access to markets and global value chains can help farmers integrate into the economy.
Note that digital technologies and inclusive business models can help smallholders overcome barriers.
Describe combined value chains and sustainability certification schemes for developing sustainable markets.

tasks.task: Explain the role of public policies and private sector actions in promoting global value chains.

subtasks.text: Mention public policies and private sector actions to promote the development of global value chains.

tasks.task: Emphasize the integral role of agricultural markets and trade in the global food system.

subtasks.text: Note that agricultural markets and trade are an integral part of the global food system.
Describe the collective responsibility in ensuring sustainable development through agricultural markets and trade.
